newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's Krotoszyn eyes PLN 5-6 mln munibond issue.
newsitem.headline: Poland's Krotoszyn eyes PLN 5-6 mln munibond issue.

text.p: The town of Krotoszyn, located in western Poland, plans to privately place municipal bonds worth 5-6 million zlotys around the middle of the year after it finds an issue agent, a city official said on Thursday.
"We expect the issue to take place in June or July and we target the amount of 5-6 million zlotys," Lucyna Bogdanska, an official from Krotoszyn's promotion department told Reuters.
Bogdanska said Krotoszyn would likely choose the agent of the issue by the end of March. The cash would be spent on creating a rehabilition centre in the city.
